# sigma_team_membership (Resource)

Adds a member to a team. The composite ID is `<team_id>:<member_id>`. Sigma has no single-membership read endpoint, so each refresh consults the team's full roster; the roster is listed once per team per Terraform run and reused across all of that team's memberships. For very large rosters (hundreds–thousands of members) prefer managing the set in the Sigma UI, as one `sigma_team_membership` resource per member is still one tracked resource each.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_team_membership" "alice_in_analytics" {
  team_id   = sigma_team.analytics.id
  member_id = sigma_member.alice.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_id` (String) Member UUID.
- `team_id` (String) Team UUID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `<team_id>:<member_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_team_membership.example '<team_id>:<member_id>'
```
